name: Pomodoro
purpose: A focused Pomodoro timer app: 25-minute focus sessions alternating with 5-minute short breaks and a 15-minute long break every four sessions, with a session history for signed-in users.
actors: Guest (uses the timer without an account)
Signed-in user (timer plus persisted session history)

entities.name: TimerSession
relationships: belongs_to user (optional — guests' sessions are not persisted)

workflows.name: Run a focus cycle
workflows.description: Start/pause/reset the countdown; timer auto-advances focus to short break to focus, and to a long break every four sessions, beeping on completion; completed sessions are saved for signed-in users.

workflows.name: Review history
workflows.description: Signed-in user browses completed sessions with per-day focus totals.

seed_demo: A demo user with several completed focus/break sessions spread over recent days so the history view and day totals show real data.
